feature.change: **Horizon video ingest processing** - Fixed an issue where `ProcessVideoIngestJob` could fail to be dispatched when stale unique job locks remained after interrupted processing or worker timeouts. Replaced `ShouldBeUnique` with `ShouldBeUniqueUntilProcessing` to prevent persistent locks from blocking future ingest jobs. Increased the job timeout to better support long-running video ingest processing. Unique job identifiers are now environment-aware to avoid collisions between staging and production environments sharing the same Redis instance.
